title: Hyperbolic and Exponential Functions: y = a/x + q and y = abˣ + q
seo_title: Grade 10 Hyperbolic and Exponential Worksheets with Answers (CAPS Maths)
standard_text: Investigate the effect of a and q on the graphs of y = a/x + q and y = abˣ + q (b > 0, b ≠ 1); find the domain, range, intercepts with the axes and asymptotes; sketch graphs and find their equations.
meta_desc: Free CAPS Grade 10 worksheets: hyperbolas y = a/x + q and exponential graphs y = abˣ + q, asymptotes, domain, range and equations. 100 questions with memos.
key_sub: y-intercept of abˣ + q is a + q.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • y = a/x + q has asymptotes x = 0 and y = q. a > 0: branches in quadrants 1 and 3; a < 0: quadrants 2 and 4.
  • y = abˣ + q has the asymptote y = q and cuts the y-axis at a + q (because b⁰ = 1).
  • b > 1 with a > 0: increasing; 0 < b < 1 with a > 0: decreasing.
  • Find a or b by substituting a point.

Examples

Example

y = 3/x − 2

asymptotes x = 0, y = −2

Answer: x ≠ 0, y ≠ −2

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
x = qThe horizontal asymptote is y = q.
b⁰b⁰ = 1, so the y-intercept is a + q.
b < 1(½)ˣ decreases.
